purpose: Label-free sensor-domain characterization only; no model/threshold/selection change
geometry: Only player/ball xy, source frame clocks and independently supplied periods. No target GT, events, tagging or possession predictions.
statistic: Per-axis median absolute deviation of consecutive 3-frame second differences / (0.67448975*sqrt(6)); iid-equivalent roughness in metres, not an identified true noise variance
period_policy: All published playing-period frames; finite consecutive triples within a period; no manually selected windows
comparison: One original DFL development game at native25Hz, clean and same seeded iid0.5m/2m jitter without bursts. Target raw25Hz tactical geometry.
outbound: Only aggregate figures; target aggregates remain in ignored local reports
